title: moreabout's proof mints its two nexi through scratch_nexus, so its tables cannot outlive the run
intention: test_chart_moreabout.py takes its two corpora (near and under-floor) from tree.scratch_nexus, held for the run and dropped at exit or swept by pid, instead of naming nexus tables by hand and dropping them in a finally that a killed run never reaches.
why: The proof names orient_ma_<pid>_<HHMMSS> tables with nexus_table() at import (lines 50-53) and drops them in _cleanup(); a run killed before its finally leaves both standing with no scratch row, so the sweep can never take them. Measured: three orient_ma tables stand live with no cairn_scratch row.
traces_to: Law 7 (a proof's leak is loud and swept, never silent); ticket 201a37bf1613 (a scratch table cannot outlive its process).
how: D1: _NEXUS and _NEXUS_FAR are entered through scratch_nexus('orient_ma'/'orient_far', owner=moreabout.OWNER) on first use inside the run (an ExitStack the _main closes), never at import; _TABLES and _cleanup's hand DROP and registry DELETE go. Every tooth keeps its claim. A new tooth (clause 2) reads store.scratch_rows() while the run holds them and finds both tables registered under this pid.

out: the trees tool's refusal of an unregistered scratch-shaped leaf (its own ticket, cast beside this one)
dropping the leaked tables standing now (a one-shot after both land)

measured.saw: 12 scratch-shaped leaf tables stand in the live db on akiendelllinux with no cairn_scratch row: chart_orient_ma_3806085_035424_nodes, codemother_orient_ma_385611_000335_nodes, codemother_orient_ma_386501_000504_nodes (maker 1), chart_testing_e8fe_474350_0355571390_nodes, chart_testing_e8fe_523256_0447136138_nodes and four codemother_testing_e8fe_*_nodes (maker 2), plus two scratch_kill_*_delivery; akiendelllinux's census counted 22 earlier the same day
measured.how: pg_tables over the live db beside store.scratch_rows() (empty for every one), by akienasus_cc_0; census by akiendelllinux_cc_0, relayed 2026-11-14

measured.saw: lines 50-53 build _TABLES with nexus_table() at import; _cleanup drops them in _main's finally

outcomes.claim: every existing tooth of test_chart_moreabout.py runs green over nexi minted by scratch_nexus
while the run holds them, both nexus tables have a cairn_scratch row under this pid, and no name in the proof mints or drops a table by hand
a run killed mid-proof (SIGKILL after the first deposit) leaves both tables for the pid sweep: store's sweep drops them on its next run

constraints: the two nexi come from scratch_nexus; the hand cleanup and the import-time names go; the registry and kill teeth join.
